meta_description: Chapman Plumbing & Heating in Middlesbrough. Emergency plumber, boiler repairs, installations, and heating services. Fast response, local expertise. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler? We're out to you in under an hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Middlesbrough
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full central heating installations, we handle every plumbing and heating need.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We attend most emergencies within 60 minutes and carry parts on the van to get you sorted the same day.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating efficient and safe. Annual servicing catches problems early; our repairs restore full heat output and cut your bills.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New system or upgrade? We design, install, and commission complete heating systems with 10-year warranties and energy-efficient controls.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Balancing
services.desc: Cold spots gone. We install new radiators, balance your system, and bleed air to ensure even warmth throughout your home.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap replacements, new suite installation, and pipework upgrades. We work neatly, leave no mess, and connect everything to code.

services.title: Power Flushing & System Cleaning
services.desc: Sludge and debris reduce efficiency and cause breakdowns. Power flushing clears your system, improves heating, and extends boiler life.

about_pullquote: I started this to do plumbing the right way—honest prices, no surprises, done properly.
about_para_1: Chapman Plumbing & Heating has served Middlesbrough, Stockton, and the surrounding areas for 18 years. We've built our reputation on turning up on time, fixing it first time, and charging fair prices. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned boiler installation, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we're local, we answer our phone, and we don't charge a call-out fee. We're Gas Safe Registered and fully insured, and we've completed over 2,000 jobs across the Tees Valley. Most of our new work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth—that's how you know we're doing something right.
reviews_heading: What Middlesbrough Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at 11pm on a Sunday. Phoned Chapman's in a panic and they picked up straight away. Bloke was round within an hour, fixed it properly, and didn't charge me extra for being out of hours. Brilliant service. Will use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Replaced our old boiler and radiators. The lads were tidy, explained everything, and the new system heats the whole house properly for the first time. Price was fair and they gave us a 10-year guarantee in writing. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Julie W.

reviews.text: Leaking tap turned out to be a bigger job than expected. Instead of ripping us off, they quoted honestly and got the work done quickly. No hidden costs. That's why I've used them three times now.
reviews.author: David P.
